headline: Public Backlash Grows Against AI Data Center Buildout
summary: Public opposition to data centers is surging, with commentators split between validating the backlash and defending the industry.

voices.quote:
A year ago, just 42% of Americans opposed a data center being built in their community.

Today, a staggering 75% do.

Are data centers really that bad? Let’s take a look.

Sometimes, you’ve got to give the people what they want — a data center moratorium and maybe the industry can come back with a more appealing pitch.
